story_zh: 小明感冒了，鼻子不通，耳朵疼，还发烧。他个子高，但最近胖了五公斤，腿和脚也疼。妈妈很着急，带他去药店。医生说：“小心环境，多喝水就不渴了。别生气，要照顾身体。”现在小明每天锻炼，脸瘦了，嘴也不说“我坏了”。他更健康了！
story_pinyin: Xiǎo Míng gǎnmào le, bízi bù tōng, ěrduo téng, hái fāshāo. Tā gèzi gāo, dàn zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, tuǐ hé jiǎo yě téng. Māma hěn zháojí, dài tā qù yàodiàn. Yīshēng shuō: “Xiǎoxīn huánjìng, duō hē shuǐ jiù bù kě le. Bié shēngqì, yào zhàogù shēntǐ.” Xiànzài Xiǎo Míng měitiān duànliàn, liǎn shòu le, zuǐ yě bù shuō “wǒ huài le”. Tā gèng jiànkāng le!
story_en: Xiao Ming has a cold, his nose is stuffy, his ears hurt, and he has a fever. He is tall, but recently gained five kilograms, and his legs and feet also hurt. His mother is very worried and takes him to the pharmacy. The doctor says, "Be careful of the environment, drink more water so you won't be thirsty. Don't be angry, take care of your body." Now Xiao Ming exercises every day, his face is thinner, and he no longer says "I'm broken." He is healthier!
